content: Xoossay Abramera Caaqida Caaquwa
Hessafe guye, Goday Abrames amuhon qoncidi,
Shin Abramey, “Abeeti Ubba Haariya Godaw, neeni immiya woytoy taw aysee? Taw yeloy baawa; buroo tana laattanay Damasqo Eli7azara gidennee?
Abramey, neeni taw yelo immaboonna gisho ta keethan de7iya ta aylley tana laattana” yaagis.
Goday iyako, “Ha aylley nena laattenna, shin ne gulbatape keyana ne na7ay nena laattana” yaagis.
Yaagi simmidi iya kare kessidi, “Pude salo xeella, neeni xoolintota paydanaw danda7iko payda, hiza ne sheeshayka hessada gidana” yaagis.
Abramey Godaa ammanis; Goday iyaw hessa xillotethi oothidi ekis.
Qassika Goday iyako, “Neeni ha biitta laattana mela Kaldaaweta biittafe Uure katamaape nena kessida Goday tana” yaagis.
Shin Abramey iyako, “Abeeti Ubba Haariya Godaw ha biitta ta laatanaysa aybin ero?” yaagis.
Goday iyako, “Heedzu laythi gidida issi ussi, issi deeshi, issi dorsenne hessadaka hollenne gorille taw ekada ya” yaagis.
Abramey hessata ubba Xoossas ehidi kafoti attishin, harata qanxidi nam7u kessi shaakidi issuwa issuwa ginan wothis.
Ankoti he ashuwa maanaw bollafe wodhidosona; shin Abramey enta goodis.
Awi wullana haniya wode Abrame wolqaama dhiskoy shoci yeggis. Daganthiya wolqaama dhumi iya bolla wodhis.
Goday Abrameko, “Ne sheeshay allaga biittan bete asi gididi daanaysa loythada era; enti aylletethan oyddu xeetu laythi naaqeti haaretana.
Shin entana aylletethan haariya deriya ta pirdana; enti he biittafe keyishe daro shalo ekidi keyana.
Nena gidiko, neeni ne mayzatako sarotethan baana. Neeni daro cimada moogetana.
Ne sheeshay buroo oyddantho yeletethan ha biitta simmana. Ayis giiko, Amooreta nagaray pirdetana likiya buroo gakibeenna” yaagis.
Awi wullin sa7i dhuma linxi gin, cooce tama cuyinne tama lacoy bentidi shaaketida ashuwa giddora aadhis.
He gallas Goday Abrames, “Gibxe shaafape doomidi Efraxiisa shaafa gakanaw de7iya biitta ubbaa taani ne sheeshas immana.
He biittay Qeenata biitta, Qenezata biitta, Qadimooneta biitta,
Hiteta biitta, Parzeta biitta, Raafaymeta biitta,
Amooreta biitta, Kanaaneta biitta, Gergeseta biittanne Yaabuseta biitta” yaagidi caaqis.
